positions.name: AtlasRollbackRehearsalCadence
positions.frame: what makes the Atlas rollback a capability we actually have, and how is its rehearsal scheduled and owned?
positions.why: Quinton's directive sets the monthly Atlas rollback rehearsal rule. His maxim gives the reason: an unrehearsed rollback is no rollback. The memo's cadence and owner lines record the same decision, naming monthly rehearsals and Quinton as owner. All four read toward one question, which is how rollback readiness is kept real through a rehearsal practice with a named owner. Quinton states the rule and the reason. The memo restates it as a structured record. The set holds no tension.
